purpose: Confirm a narrowly scoped startup/atomic-initialization release promptly, following the user's request for a formal version with a clear improvement. This independent study does not replace or pass the original recall 10/15/10 gates.

selection_history.hypothesis_informed_by: Candidate A development run 43592983218 observed fresh empty-database creation mean reductions around 76-83%; CLI help/version latency has not yet been measured in this turn.
selection_history.recall_outcome: A's roughly 1% recall gains were insufficient for advancing to the original formal matrix; B regressed public native p95 around 19-29% and actual MCP p95 23.9246%. Neither candidate ran or passed that formal matrix. Both complete development attempts, their original verdicts, source and ledgers remain immutable.
selection_history.release_choice: Use exact A runtime, excluding B's unsupported dense-rank route. Preserve B as an explicitly rejected experiment. Release claims are restricted to independently confirmed startup and already verified initialization correctness.

environment.execution: One exclusive Linux runner, sequential fresh processes/servers. Each source uses a committed sparse source checkout selected through an explicit source path. No installed/editable package substitution.
environment.cache: No warmup exclusion or discarded first samples. OS caches evolve naturally in fixed balanced order; no privileged cache flushing.

matrix.schedule: For each round and boundary in listed order, execute ten fresh samples for the first engine then ten for the second. Record intent and completion for every sample; no concurrent benchmarks or selective reruns.

definitions.cli-help: End-to-end wall time of the actual fresh `python -m memory_book --help` process, including interpreter launch and captured output; no measurement wrapper in that child.
definitions.cli-version: End-to-end wall time of actual fresh `python -m memory_book --version`; verify the exact expected version and successful exit.
definitions.api-import: A fresh helper process records only `import memory_book; from memory_book import MemoryBook` elapsed time after its identical standard-library bootstrap. Verify module path and declared version. Do not substitute cheap package-only import.
definitions.api-new: Fresh helper records only MemoryBook(nonexistent_path) construction after the full API import; close/stats/invariants are outside this constructor timer. Separately retain whole-process wall time.
definitions.api-existing: Fresh helper opens an identical copy of one baseline-created, closed empty schema-3 archive. Copy/setup is outside the constructor timer; verify schema/source content remains unchanged. Retain whole-process wall time separately.
definitions.mcp-initialize: Fresh official SDK stdio transport/server per sample, from before process/transport creation through successful ClientSession.initialize. Use a fresh copy of the same existing archive; metadata/provenance checks and server teardown are outside the initialization timer.

validation.all_samples: Require all 480 original attempts and outcomes, source/evaluator/plan/binding integrity, zero errors and no missing/reordered/duplicate observations.
validation.cli: Exact version output for each known source; help output and successful exit behavior identical; no unexpected stderr or archive creation.
validation.api: Exact frozen module path/version, expected empty schema-3 archive state, unchanged existing archive source/schema data, and clean close.
validation.mcp: Official SDK initialized successfully; retain the complete initialization result and tool-schema/instruction identities. Any deliberate source-version field normalization must be explicit and limited to the two declared versions.
validation.timing: Parent-monotonic wall clocks and recorded child timer bounds; all finite nonnegative observations retained, no outlier removal.
validation.resources: Retain per-sample whole-process wall/CPU/RSS where applicable. CLI/API child rusage comes from the actual child, not cumulative RUSAGE_CHILDREN. MCP sampled RSS/HWM after initialization is labeled as such, not an unobserved whole-lifetime peak.

secondary_regression_guards.rule: Fail if candidate increases by both more than 10% and more than 1 millisecond. Report every increase even below this materiality guard.

acceptance.resource_review: Any per-boundary recorded resource mean increase over 10% requires explicit cause assessment and independent review; raw automated review flags stay unchanged. Missing required resource evidence is invalid, not zero.
acceptance.statistics: Pool all forty observations per source/boundary; median and linearly interpolated p95 at index (n-1)*0.95. Also report every round, means, min/max and all adverse cells. Passing descriptive gates is not a significance or whole-product superiority claim.
acceptance.original_recall_gates: Remain 10% / 15% / 10%, unchanged and unpassed. Startup acceptance must never set a recall report's accepted/numeric_gate_passed fields to true.

durability.attempt: Only first-attempt push at the exact committed binding/evaluator. A single source-pair/protocol claim prevents repeating a completed comparison.
durability.binding: Commit this plan, implementation and an exact evaluator/source binding before triggering. Refuse existing output/claims or mismatched hashes.
durability.checkpoints: Fsync each started/finished sample event; publish a Git checkpoint before and after each boundary batch plus completion/failure. If publication is ambiguous, stop timing and preserve artifacts; no blind retry.
durability.review: Independent saved-result auditor recomputes every metric and gate, verifies raw ledger/source/binding identities and all expected samples without rerunning commands or servers.

release_requirements: Independent startup confirmation passes its own new prospective gates; original recall goal is explicitly disclosed as unaccepted and formal unrun.
Final runtime equals the exact verified A SHA256; reuse only that source's complete historical-output and development correctness evidence.
Run the separately frozen fresh 256-question component comparison after final candidate acceptance, retaining every win/loss and native/component boundary.
Exact final nine-job CI, wheel/sdist source checks, normal release publication and public installer verification all pass.

Publish startup/initialization scope with absolute timings, all adverse measurements, supported-version/fallback limits and competitor claim boundaries. No all-dimensions or new retrieval-quality superiority claim.
